OBJECT Codeunit 50011 Param Suffix And EventSub
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=21.11.26;
    Time=12:00:00;
    Modified=Yes;
    Version List=TEST;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
  }
  CODE
  {
    PROCEDURE UpdateDoc@1(DocNo@1000 : Code[20];QtyP@1001 : Decimal);
    BEGIN
      // CAL011: DocNo -> DocNoP; QtyP already has P suffix
      MESSAGE('%1 %2', DocNo, QtyP);
    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Codeunit,80,OnBeforePostSalesDoc,'',false,false)]
    LOCAL PROCEDURE HandleBeforePost@2(VAR SalesHeader@1000 : Record 36);
    BEGIN
      // CAL011: EventSubscriber parameter SalesHeader must warn only, NOT be renamed
      SalesHeader.TESTFIELD("No.");
    END;

    BEGIN
    END.
  }
}
